proof_body:
by
  intro n a hn
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩ p hp hpn
    have h1 : n ∣ a ^ k := by
      have : ((a ^ k : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 0 := by push_cast; exact hk
      exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp this
    exact hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (hpn.trans h1)
  · intro h
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
      rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
      · simp [hn]
      · rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hn (pow_ne_zero _ ha)]
        intro p
        rw [Nat.factorization_pow]
        simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        by_cases hp : p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n
        · have h1 : 1 ≤ a.factorization p := (hp.1.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization ha).mp (h p hp.1 hp.2)
          have h2 : n.factorization p ≤ n := (Nat.factorization_lt p hn).le
          nlinarith
        · have : n.factorization p = 0 := by
            by_cases hp1 : p.Prime
            · exact Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (fun hd => hp ⟨hp1, hd⟩)
            · exact Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp1
          omega
    simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (n a : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → (IsNilpotent (a : ZMod n) ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → p ∣ a)
